About This Game

The word association party game that took the world by storm. Split into two teams, spymasters give one-word clues to guide their teammates to the right words — but watch out for the assassin.

Why we picked it: Easy to teach, plays up to 8, always different. Best party game for non-gamers.

How to Play

Codenames plays with 4-8 players and takes about 15 minutes. It is recommended for ages 14+ with a complexity rating of 1.2 out of 5.

The goal depends on the game type. Party Games games focus on quick, fun games for 4+ players. perfect for game nights and gatherings.. Each round pushes players to make decisions, adapt to the board state, and outplay their opponents.

Setup is straightforward. The rulebook is designed to get you playing fast, not reading for 30 minutes. Most groups understand the flow within the first round.

What Makes It Fun

The best part of Codenames is how it creates moments. Every session has a story. A comeback win. A close call. A move that made everyone at the table react.

It balances luck and skill. New players can win. Experienced players can consistently do well. That balance keeps the game coming back to the table.

Who Is It For

This game works best for groups that enjoy party games. If you like thinking on your feet, reading the table, and games that change every time, Codenames is a solid pick.

It works for both casual players and experienced gamers. The rules are light enough for beginners but the decisions are deep enough for veterans.
